title: Building the Data Engine for Autonomous Systems
summary: Scale ground truth for robotics & AVs with the 5C framework. Read Everest Group's report to turn field data into reliable AI learning.
body_markdown:
Physical AI systems, from autonomous vehicles (AV) to robotics, are stepping out of controlled facilities and into unpredictable settings. Today, these machines are performing more dynamic tasks, making more complex decisions and working alongside real people. Winning the market comes down to how fast systems learn from field data and exposure.


Unlocking true autonomy and reliability demands high-fidelity ground truth and a stable learning pipeline. Technical teams must transform egocentric captures into high-precision machine intelligence, enforce strict quality standards, stress-test systems against edge cases and fuel continuous training cycles during live operations.


In this report, Everest Group explores the data operating model that sharpens machine performance and safety.


Key insights include:


- **The 5C ground truth model:** How to turn physical world signals into autonomy intelligence
- **Cross-functional operating models:** Aligning engineering, safety and operations teams around consistent quality standards
- **Partner ecosystems:** Why working with specialized partners expand capacity while keeping full control over core IP and safety decisions
